name: School☆Lover
source:
My life is over.
My huge fetish for school swimwear was found out by childhood friend Saki.
Surely, I must prepare for an onslaught of verbal abuse.
But, it seems she's thinking quite differently.
Did I just dodge a disaster? Oh boy!
It's the start of a sweet sex-filled life! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075150.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我的人生完蛋了。
我对学校泳装的巨大癖好被青梅竹马咲发现了。
我肯定得做好迎接她言语攻击的准备。
可是，她的想法似乎完全不同。
我这是躲过一场灾难了吗？天啊！
一段甜蜜而充满性爱的生活就此开始！
